newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RANGERS' LANGDON SUSPENDED FOR INSTIGATING BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-RANGERS' LANGDON SUSPENDED FOR INSTIGATING BRAWL.

text.p: New York Rangers left wing Darren Langdon was suspended by the National Hockey League Friday, pending a hearing on Saturday, for instigating a fight in Thursday night's 6-2 victory over the Los Angeles Kings.
Langdon was to miss at least Friday's game at Anaheim.
He received a minor penalty for instigating, a major penalty for fighting and a 10-minute misconduct following a brawl with Kings left wing Matt Johnson with 32 seconds to go in the second period.
The fight was the second of the game for Langdon, who also brawled with Doug Zmolek early in the first period.
